Note that the explosions caused by weapons are not the same as those triggered by receiving damage or destroying a light source, and thus have different sources of base damage.

Heart of Fire (XIX) also causes light sources to explode when destroyed and summons a retaliatory explosion when the player is damaged. When retaliating, it creates an explosion around the character and can retaliate every 0.5 seconds.
If none of the listed weapons are present, the explosion from destroying light sources and the retaliatory explosion deals the default base damage of 10. These explosions are affected by
The base damage of Heart of Fire (XIX)'s retaliatory explosions will increase by 5 for every listed weapon held, starting from the second weapon.

Weapons that have low or no piercing, like the Fire Wand or Long Gun, benefit from this Arcana massively, as it allows them to deal area damage and multiplies their crowd damage output.

Since the explosion happens per enemy contact, weapons with infinite pierce like Hellfire and Valkyrie Turner (and Gunastrophe) become even more powerful as they shred through enemies while also creating an explosion with each hit. The sheer amount of bullets and later pierce from Phiera Der Tuphello can also create a huge amount of explosions.
Only the base damage of the weapon is used for the calculation of the explosion damage so Valkyrie Turner's charge up does not affect it.
Light source and retaliatory explosions deal double damage for Phiera Der Tuphello as it starts with a base damage of 5, this bonus will be overridden by other weapons.
